# Supported formats

<!-- Generated by `fileconv formats --markdown docs/FORMATS.md`. Don't edit by hand. -->

Everything is converted on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.

Most office formats need the free [LibreOffice](https://www.libreoffice.org/download/) to be installed. The column **Works right away** lists what works without it.

## All formats

| Format | File extensions | Type |
|--------|-----------------|------|
| **JPG**: JPEG image | .jpg, .jpeg, .jfif, .jpe | Images |
| **PNG**: PNG image | .png | Images |
| **WEBP**: WebP image | .webp | Images |
| **BMP**: Bitmap image | .bmp, .dib | Images |
| **TIFF**: TIFF image | .tiff, .tif | Images |
| **GIF**: GIF image | .gif | Images |
| **ICO**: Windows icon | .ico | Images |
| **HEIC**: HEIC/HEIF image (iPhone) | .heic, .heif | Images |
| **AVIF**: AVIF image | .avif | Images |
| **PDF**: PDF document | .pdf | PDF |
| **DOCX**: Word document | .docx | Text documents |
| **DOC**: Word 97-2003 document | .doc | Text documents |
| **ODT**: OpenDocument text | .odt | Text documents |
| **RTF**: Rich Text Format | .rtf | Text documents |
| **TXT**: Plain text | .txt | Text documents |
| **XLSX**: Excel workbook | .xlsx | Spreadsheets |
| **XLS**: Excel 97-2003 workbook | .xls | Spreadsheets |
| **ODS**: OpenDocument spreadsheet | .ods | Spreadsheets |
| **CSV**: CSV (comma-separated values) | .csv | Spreadsheets |
| **PPTX**: PowerPoint presentation | .pptx | Presentations |
| **PPT**: PowerPoint 97-2003 presentation | .ppt | Presentations |
| **ODP**: OpenDocument presentation | .odp | Presentations |

## Text documents

| From | Works right away | Also with LibreOffice installed |
|------|------------------|--------------------------------|
| **DOCX** | – | DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF |
| **DOC** | – | DOCX, ODT, RTF, TXT, BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF |
| **ODT** | – | DOC, DOCX, RTF, TXT, BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF |
| **RTF** | – | DOC, DOCX, ODT, TXT, BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF |
| **TXT** | – | DOC, DOCX, ODT, RTF, BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF |

- Word → image goes through PDF and creates one image per page.

## PDF

| From | Works right away | Also with LibreOffice installed |
|------|------------------|--------------------------------|
| **PDF** | DOCX, TXT, BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP | DOC, ODT, RTF |

- PDF → image creates one image per page (`name_page001.png`, …). TIFF puts all pages into one multi-page file.
- PDF → Word rebuilds an editable layout. Scanned PDFs (pictures of pages) need text recognition (OCR), which is planned.
- Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first.

## Spreadsheets

| From | Works right away | Also with LibreOffice installed |
|------|------------------|--------------------------------|
| **XLSX** | – | BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF, CSV, ODS, XLS |
| **XLS** | – | BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF, CSV, ODS, XLSX |
| **ODS** | – | BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF, CSV, XLS, XLSX |
| **CSV** | – | BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF, ODS, XLS, XLSX |

- CSV keeps only the first sheet, without formatting.

## Presentations

| From | Works right away | Also with LibreOffice installed |
|------|------------------|--------------------------------|
| **PPTX** | – | BMP, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF, ODP, PPT |

## Images

| From | Works right away | Also with LibreOffice installed |
|------|------------------|--------------------------------|
| **JPG** | AVIF, BMP, GIF, HEIC, ICO, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF | – |
| **PNG** | AVIF, BMP, GIF, HEIC, ICO, JPG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF | – |
| **WEBP** | AVIF, BMP, GIF, HEIC, ICO, JPG, PNG, TIFF, PDF | – |
| **BMP** | AVIF, GIF, HEIC, ICO, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF | – |
| **TIFF** | AVIF, BMP, GIF, HEIC, ICO, JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF | – |
| **GIF** | AVIF, BMP, HEIC, ICO, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF | – |
| **ICO** | AVIF, BMP, GIF, HEIC, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF | – |
| **HEIC** | AVIF, BMP, GIF, ICO, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF | – |
| **AVIF** | BMP, GIF, HEIC, ICO, JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP, PDF | – |

- Photo metadata (camera, date, GPS location) is removed by default.
- Formats without transparency (JPG, BMP, PDF) get a white background.
- Animated GIF/WebP and multi-page TIFF keep all frames when the target supports it.

## Also available

- **Merge PDFs:** `fileconv pdf merge a.pdf b.pdf -o combined.pdf`
- **Split a PDF into single pages:** `fileconv pdf split file.pdf`

Planned formats (audio, video, e-books, archives, …) are listed in the [project plan](PROJECT_PLAN.md).
